meta.name: Corpus — divergent clock
meta._note: Regression fixture distilled from 34 sessions of 'La naissance d'un roi' (docs/10-field-report.md §3.2). Four writers of game time disagree: the declared clock says day 58, events.json says day 63 (+5, the S31 divergence), and the living-world clock says day 109 (+51, the divergence measured at t_reference). meta.time deliberately omits units_per_day: the campaign that produced this pathology never declared it, and the scale must still be readable from the code.
